source: [INFERENCE] An analyst opens the highlighted crop beside the extracted number and compares digits; about 1 to 2 minutes per cell including the correction, taken at 1.5.
[INFERENCE] A failed tie flags several figures; the analyst finds the misread or mistyped one by re-adding the column on the page, so about 3 minutes per failed tie flag.
[INFERENCE] The row is already extracted with its number; the analyst only decides whether the line matters to the model, a glance of about 30 seconds.
[INFERENCE] The analyst compares the figure with the prior-year report and reads the restatement note to decide which value stands, about 4 minutes per figure.
[INFERENCE] The printed unit line is missing or unclear; the analyst finds the unit on the page or cover and confirms it once per document, about 2 minutes.
[INFERENCE] Two independent OCR readings of the cell differ; the analyst reads the page crop and picks the right digits, about 2 minutes per cell.
